contract.cycle_definition: Each of 50 pairs: request real screen capture -> Active/published/binding/frame -> actual AnnotationOverlayWindow with a Qt Pen gesture -> overlay destroyed -> share Idle/unpublished/unbound.
contract.cycle_order: One share at a time, round-robin across all four writers; writing continues on all four.

network.actual_WAN_RTT: Measured separately; netem two-leg delay is not an exact WAN RTT assertion

contract.late_join: Eighth independent process joins after warm-up Pen strokes, before the 1800-second window
contract.leave: Non-authority late peer leaves after final eight-peer hash convergence; seven survivors must retain the document
contract.scope: One computer, eight logical product peers and owned SFU. Pen commands and real screen/overlay lifecycle; no cross-DPI or subjective remote alignment credit.
